answer: Each identity carries a nonce-chained work ledger: each task is a signed record hashing the previous one, a jetty of planks over a river of untrusted traffic. Reputation accrues only along this single chain, so forking into parallel copies is useless - peers countersign and timestamp chain heads, and chains sharing ancestry are detected and merged, keeping the longest. A nebula of cheap fakes starts with empty ledgers, since earning nonces needs serialized, spot-checkable work. Attacker cost: O(n) real computation per identity, no shortcut.
